mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop ( shop_name, shop_abbreviation, product_type, business_status, village, shop_intro, shop_avatar, shop_address, qualification_files, user_id, display_no latitude, longitude, ) VALUES ( #{shopName}, #{shopAbbreviation}, #{productType}, #{businessStatus}, #{village}, #{shopIntro}, #{shopAvatar}, #{shopAddress}, #{qualificationFiles}, #{userId}, #{displayNo} #{latitude}, #{longitude}, )
mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_name, shop_abbreviation, product_type, business_status, village, shop_intro, shop_avatar, shop_address, latitude, longitude, qualification_files, user_id, display_no, create_time, update_time FROM shop WHERE id = #{value}
